comodidades.h2: Pools, Fireplace, Cinema and Two Gourmet Areas.
comodidades.sub: Plus an optional team of 3 to 5 people to cook, tidy and serve.
comodidades.a.title: Pools and Fireplace
comodidades.a.text: Ground-floor infinity-edge pool with a heated hydromassage. Heated upper pool, with hydromassage, on the living room veranda. Eco-friendly alcohol fireplace by the pool, for 12 people.
comodidades.b.title: Gourmet Areas
comodidades.b.text: Ground floor: gas grill, beer cooler, ice maker and pizza oven. Upper floor: charcoal grill, beer cooler, ice maker and wine cellar.
comodidades.c.title: Cinema and Gym
comodidades.c.text: 4K projection on a 120-inch screen, 5.1 surround sound and electric reclining seats, with streaming, for 10 people. Gym in the house.
comodidades.d.title: Comfort
comodidades.d.house.t: Wi-Fi, kitchen, workspace, beach access, loungers by the pool and private parking for 12 cars, 6 covered.
comodidades.d.suites.t: Minibar, TV, electric curtains and air conditioning.
comodidades.d.condo.t: 24-hour security and 2 pedestrian gates to the village.
comodidades.e.title: Optional Team
comodidades.e.text: Cook, housekeeper and bartender, in a team of 3 to 5 people. Daily rates from R$ 270 to R$ 320, depending on the role. Charged separately.
